about: The season plan's stages as data (docs/season-plan.md). Edited by the planning chat; the service reads it at boot and whenever it changes (task 036). A stage is current until every fighter has reached `fighters`; the last stage stays. A field left out of a stage narrows nothing. crafts / gathering: the level a skill is trained to in this stage, not past it. pieces: the only wearables the fighters' gear work may ask for (made or bought). achievements: the only achievements chased as objectives; any other still completes when it happens. The professional_ and master_ gathering achievements are listed in every stage on purpose: they are the far gates of the workers' lanes, so a lane's tool (steel axe, steel pickaxe, steel fishing rod) still pays over its road (036's report, D.4). grand_master (combat 50) is listed in every stage for the same reason: it is the fighters' far gate, without it a fighter has no road for a listed piece to pay over and a training has no points (037's report, decision 1). The lich's pieces (greater_dreadful_staff, conjurer_cloak, flying_boots, emerald_ring, obsidian_helmet) and lich_please / life_lover are listed in stages 1 and 2 since 039's table: only a trio takes the lich, in these level-30 pieces, from Second at combat 30; the party's step and its needs come with 039b.
aboutGold: Task 041 (report 040, Alex 11-28). sell: a code the merchants' standing order sells down to the count kept in the bank, to the merchant that buys it; nothing off this list is sold. Sap is not on it on purpose (Alex: little to earn, it stays). Diamonds, small pearls (the perfect pearl), strange ore and wolf ears are kept. The 8 gems of a kind cover the stage's pieces (5 emeralds, 2 sapphires) and the gold tools. cut: products of one material the mining holder makes from the bank's stock (24 stones a gem). Until task 041 is in, the service ignores both.
